$comment: AR capture plan §5.3/§11 — proximity-band classifier cross-language parity fixture. Executed by both backend/server-node/test/arCaptureParity.ts (TypeScript) and test/proximity_parity_test.dart (Dart). All cases use the plan's default band thresholds (cold=300, warm=150, hot=60, burning=25) and ProximityBandCalculator.classify's signature: classify(distanceMeters, thresholds, previousBand) -> band. Do not edit one language's copy without re-running both suites.

cases.label: just past the frozen/cold boundary is cold
just past the cold/warm boundary is warm
just past the warm/hot boundary is hot
at the capture radius is burning
moving hotter is immediate, no margin
moving from frozen straight to burning is immediate
small drift past a boundary while cooling stays in the old band (margin)
clearing the hot boundary by more than the margin demotes to warm
small drift past the cold boundary while cooling stays cold (15% margin dominates at this range)
clearing the cold boundary by more than the margin demotes to frozen
staying exactly put reclassifies to the same band
leaving burning requires clearing its margin (max(8, 15%) = 8m)
clearing burning's margin demotes to hot
zero distance is always burning regardless of history
